en: Fixed PDFs, images and `.docx`, `.xlsx` or `.pptx` files that MCP servers or websites send as `application/octet-stream` being saved as .bin, which kept Claude from reading the PDFs and images
zh: 修复了 MCP server 或网站以 `application/octet-stream` 发送的 PDF、图片及 `.docx`、`.xlsx` 或 `.pptx` 文件被保存为 .bin 的问题，该问题导致 Claude 无法读取这些 PDF 和图片
